recommendation: One small helper validate_optional_design_source_evidence(root, design), called by add_idea and append_review before the first write_jsonl. Do not put it in _base_records, _assemble or build_index; old records must remain readable and correctable.

locations.add_idea: tools/research_registry.py:603; validate proposal.get(design,{}) before writing ideas.jsonl
locations.append_review: tools/research_registry.py:630; validate only the newly supplied review design when present, before writing curation.jsonl. Do not revalidate the inherited raw design when the review merely documents its defects.

contract: source_evidence absent is allowed. Raw proposals need no semantic gold, semantic approval or source quotation at all. If a source quotation is asserted, it must be faithful.

Existing shape is one evidence object: all 35 current occurrences checked are dicts and all paths end .md. Smallest guard supports this existing shape; a list extension is unnecessary for the reported failure. Explicit malformed null/string/list should raise a clear ValueError rather than bypass validation.

Require repository-safe path through evidence_path, existing regular Markdown file, nonempty literal quote, positive integer line (reject bool), and a valid matching SHA256 of original bytes. Decode utf-8-sig consistently with semantic_ideas.validate_card. Compare quote.splitlines() to the exact physical source lines from line; do not join, strip, casefold, normalize indentation, repair escaping or collapse whitespace.

Optional line_end: when omitted, derive the end from the number of quote lines. When supplied, require integer end >= line and exact agreement with that derived end. A full multiline literal quote without line_end is valid.

Validate extension and resolved target extension before digest/open. Reject TSV/CSV/JSONL and binary targets in this small Markdown source-quote guard; do not read then filter. A .md symlink to .tsv must also be rejected. Direct mixed TSV quoting requires the established selector-first query-tsv workflow and is outside this change; do not implement a fallback parser.

Use source-report Markdown only; the guard verifies existing reported prose, not admission of manuscript images or raw rows. References to sealed pages inside historical reports are not permission to inspect them. Do not introduce a blanket ban on reports merely mentioning f84.
Failure leaves ideas/curation bytes and index unchanged and must not allocate a persistent ID. Keep existing write rollback for later errors. Do not rewrite any old quote or historical proposal.
tests: Synthetic multiline Markdown + matching SHA succeeds with and without line_end, including indentation and UTF-8 text; no-source_evidence raw proposal still succeeds.

Correct SHA but collapsed lines, wrong text, wrong start, wrong explicit end, stale/malformed SHA or missing file each fails before append; assert unchanged ideas/curation bytes and mock build_index not called.
For append_review, reject a newly supplied bad design quote; permit a review with no replacement design on an old bad-quote record, preserving the old bytes.
Reject unsafe or escaping paths and non-Markdown/resolved-TSV targets before source content read; use read/open spies to prove no TSV payload or digest read.
Existing lifecycle suite confirms stable IDs, historical append chains and normal review behavior. No scientific decoder tests or broad new framework.
existing_validator_limits: semantic_ideas.validate_card already verifies literal physical quote lines and optional hashes, but requires a semantic card and does not enforce explicit line_end consistency. Do not import that module into research_registry (semantic_ideas imports registry), and do not build a fake card. Copy the small line comparison into the local helper. Existing _evidence only extracts path references from blockers/relations/reopen, not design.source_evidence.
freshness_scope: This is a pre-mutation quote-integrity guard only. Adding design paths to _evidence or retroactive build validation changes historical freshness semantics and is unnecessary for this bounded fix.
